course_binding.title: CS 2824: Foundations of Reinforcement Learning
course_binding.use_boundary: Course theorems are assumption-sensitive results for stated MDP and policy classes. They motivate diagnostics and proof obligations here; they do not transfer to language-model training without an explicit mapping and verified assumptions. Guest slides are hypothesis sources, not primary evidence.

scope.objective: Determine whether spectral or entropic auxiliary signals add calibrated information beyond terminal reward, increase independently verified rewarding-trajectory coverage, and improve held-out reasoning under matched cost, without proxy exploitation, unsupported theorem transfer, length artifacts, or policy-distribution confounds.
scope.frozen_classification: registered fixed-corpus off-policy replay conformance and feasibility study

live_checkout_observation.interpretation: The live mutable checkout is not the source bound to accepted r4-2 unit receipts; the frozen review bundle remains the verification surface.

central_question: Do the proposed auxiliary trajectory scores predict independently verified correctness within homogeneous reward groups, increase rewarding-trajectory coverage, and then improve untouched held-out quality under an assumption-audited, fresh on-policy, matched-cost protocol?

hypotheses.claim: Within all-correct and all-wrong terminal-reward strata, the auxiliary score predicts independent correctness labels after controlling for completion length, token entropy, task, and model scale.
hypotheses.falsified_if: The stratified bootstrap AUC interval includes 0.5, the effect disappears under controls, or a variance-matched placebo performs equivalently.

hypotheses.claim: A gated auxiliary arm improves seed-paired held-out learning-curve AUC over the registered group-relative control at matched charged tokens and measured FLOPs.
hypotheses.falsified_if: The paired interval includes zero, improvement is not direction-consistent, or the effect vanishes on the untouched test set.

hypotheses.claim: Any quality gain persists under an independent answer verifier, prompt-format perturbation, and sampled pass@8 evaluation.
hypotheses.falsified_if: The gain is parser-specific, format-specific, or explained by a larger inference-token budget.

hypotheses.claim: Proxy improvement does not coincide with degraded held-out quality, excessive policy drift, clipping saturation, or length-cap exploitation.
hypotheses.falsified_if: Proxy score rises while held-out quality falls, reference KL crosses its preregistered bound, clipping saturates, or cap-hit rate exceeds 0.05.

hypotheses.claim: The proposed intervention increases independently verified rewarding-trajectory coverage, rather than merely producing a nonzero gradient inside the same unsupported region of policy space.
hypotheses.falsified_if: Gradient norm or auxiliary variance increases without improving correct-completion coverage, mixed-group yield, or held-out quality under a token-matched exploration sweep.

hypotheses.claim: Any learning gain survives fresh on-policy collection or a preregistered bounded-lag regime with the actual data-generating policy identified and distribution shift measured.
hypotheses.falsified_if: The gain exists only in fixed replay, disappears on-policy, depends on unbounded policy ratios or collapsed effective sample size, or cannot be separated from trainer-inference mismatch.

hypotheses.claim: The reported gain remains after separately bounding optimization, statistical-estimation, function-approximation, and answer-verification error.
hypotheses.falsified_if: The effect is no larger than any unresolved error component or changes sign under the independent verifier.

stages.gate: Create a fresh source namespace, protocol fingerprint, artifact root, and run identities; no accepted r4-2 source or receipt may be overwritten.
stages.evidence: Fresh hashes and a verifier that distinguishes the new protocol from the frozen campaign.

stages.gate: Write an assumption ledger before importing any course result into an LLM claim.
stages.evidence: For every theorem-shaped claim: exact source, formal domain, prompt/state/action/trajectory mapping, policy and comparator, data-generating distribution, support or coverage condition, approximation class, verified versus unverified assumptions, measured proxy, and falsifier. A small gradient or stationary point is never accepted as evidence of optimality by itself.

stages.gate: Test auxiliary-score calibration on independently labeled homogeneous groups before any training allocation.
stages.evidence: At least 2000 all-correct and 2000 all-wrong groups per task/model stratum, stratified bootstrap intervals, length/entropy controls, and a variance-matched placebo.

stages.gate: Construct a genuinely variable-length corpus without weakening the failed r4-2 gate.
stages.evidence: Selected-row length CV at least 0.35, completion cap-hit rate at most 0.05, EOS and parse rates reported, and byte-identical realized corpora across arms.

stages.gate: Run fresh on-policy training only after S1, S2, and S3 pass; identify the actual sampler policy and constrain policy-space drift rather than relying on clipping alone.
stages.evidence: At least five paired seeds for the group-relative control, a centered-reward baseline, spectral arm, entropic arm, and variance-matched placebo at no more than 0.01 relative charged-token or FLOP imbalance; empirical KL stop rule, sampler-policy version and lag, policy-ratio tails, effective sample size, and Fisher-quadratic step diagnostic.

stages.gate: Keep model selection on a development set and make the final decision on an untouched test set.
stages.evidence: Pass@1 and sampled pass@8, independent parser agreement, prompt-format perturbation, fixed inference-token budgets, seed-paired confidence intervals, and a reported decomposition of optimization, estimation, approximation, and verifier error.

evaluation_contract.secondary_quality: sampled pass@8 at a fixed inference-token budget

decision_rules.allocation: No GPU training is authorized by this file. Each stage must pass before the next allocation is requested.
decision_rules.claim_boundary: Synthetic nonzero advantages, nonzero gradients, timing estimates, or dashboard traces cannot support a learning, correctness, or reward-recovery claim.
decision_rules.theory_boundary: Every theorem-derived statement must name its formal domain and assumptions. Tabular or function-approximation results may be used as analogies or diagnostic motivation until the LLM mapping and assumptions are verified. Small gradient, low loss, or a clipped surrogate alone does not establish global optimality or a trust region.
decision_rules.stop: Stop on an unmapped theoretical assumption, failed calibration, absent rewarding-trajectory coverage, infeasible variable-length control, parser-specific gains, proxy/quality divergence, excessive drift, clip saturation, effective-sample-size collapse, cap exploitation, provenance mismatch, or repeated validation failure. Preserve negative results.
